40022011.author: पदार्थः
40022011.content: एवं thus, ब्रुवति while speaking, रामे Rama, तु indeed, लक्ष्मणः Lakshmana, परवीरहा the destroyer of enemy heroes, प्रत्युवाच replied, महात्मानम् to the great-souled one, ज्वलन्तम् blazing, इव as if, तेजसा with splendor.

40022011.author: Translation
40022011.content: While Rama was speaking thus, Lakshmana, the destroyer of enemy heroes, replied to the great-souled Rama, who was shining as if blazing with splendor.

40022012.author: पदार्थः
40022012.content: महत् great, अद्भुतम् wonderful, आश्चर्यम् astonishing event, विदेहस्य of Videha, पुरातनम् ancient, निर्वृत्तम् occurred, राजशार्दूल O tiger among kings, वसिष्ठस्य of Vasishtha, निमेः of Nimi, सह with.

40022012.author: Translation
40022012.content: O tiger among kings, a great and ancient astonishing event concerning Videha occurred involving Vasishtha and Nimi.

40022013.author: पदार्थः
40022013.content: निमिः Nimi, तु but, क्षत्रियः a Kshatriya, शूरः brave, विशेषेण especially, च and, दीक्षितः initiated, न not, क्षमाम् forgiveness, कृतवान् showed, राजा the king, वसिष्ठस्य of Vasishtha, महात्मनः the great-souled one.

40022013.author: Translation
40022013.content: But King Nimi, a brave Kshatriya who was especially initiated into a sacrifice, did not show forgiveness towards the great-souled Vasishtha.

40022014.author: पदार्थः
40022014.content: एवम् thus, उक्तः spoken, तु indeed, तेन by him, अयम् this, श्रीमान् glorious, क्षत्रियपुङ्गवः best among Kshatriyas, उवाच spoke, लक्ष्मणम् to Lakshmana, वाक्यम् words, सर्वशास्त्रविशारदम् skilled in all scriptures.

40022014.author: Translation
40022014.content: Thus addressed by him (Lakshmana), the glorious Rama, the best among Kshatriyas, spoke words to Lakshmana, who was skilled in all scriptures.

40022015.author: पदार्थः
40022015.content: रामो Rama, रमयतां among those who delight, श्रेष्ठो the best, भ्रातरं to his brother, दीप्ततेजसम् of blazing splendor, न not, सर्वत्र everywhere, क्षमा forgiveness/patience, वीर O hero, पुरुषेषु among men, प्रदृश्यते is seen.

40022015.author: Translation
40022015.content: Rama, the best among those who delight, addresses his brother of blazing splendor, stating that forgiveness is not always observed among all men, O hero.

40022016.author: पदार्थः
40022016.content: सौमित्रे O son of Sumitra (Lakshmana), दुःसहो difficult to bear, रोषो anger, यथा as, क्षान्तो endured/forgiven, ययातिना by Yayati, सत्त्वानुगं following virtue/goodness, पुरस्कृत्य having placed in front/considering, तत् that, निबोध understand, समाहितः with concentrated mind.

40022016.author: Translation
40022016.content: O Lakshmana, understand with a concentrated mind how the unbearable anger was endured by Yayati, considering the path of virtue.

40022017.author: पदार्थः
40022017.content: नहुषस्य of Nahusha, सुतो son, राजा king, ययातिः Yayati, पौरवर्धनः who increased the Paurava lineage, तस्य his, भार्याद्वयं two wives, सौम्य O gentle one, रूपेण in beauty, अप्रतिमं unequalled, भुवि on earth.

40022017.author: Translation
40022017.content: O gentle one, King Yayati, the son of Nahusha and augmenter of the Paurava lineage, had two wives whose beauty was unequalled on earth.

40022018.author: पदार्थः
40022018.content: एका one, तु indeed, तस्य of him, राजर्षेः of the royal sage, नाहुषस्य of Nahusha's son (Yayati), पुरस्कृता honored/chief, शर्मिष्ठा Sharmishtha, नाम named, दैतेयी daughter of a Daitya, दुहिता daughter, वृषपर्वणः of Vrishaparvan.

40022018.author: Translation
40022018.content: One of those wives, honored by the royal sage Yayati, son of Nahusha, was named Sharmishtha, the daughter of the Daitya king Vrishaparvan.

40022019.author: पदार्थः
40022019.content: अन्या the other, तु indeed, ऊशनसः of Ushanas (Shukra), पत्नी daughter (literally wife, but here refers to daughter of Ushanas who became Yayati's wife), ययातेः of Yayati, पुरुषर्षभ O best among men, न not, तु but, सा she, दयिता beloved, राज्ञो of the king, देवयानी Devayani, सुमध्यमा slender-waisted.

40022019.author: Translation
40022019.content: O best among men, the other wife of Yayati was Devayani, the daughter of Ushanas, but that slender-waisted Devayani was not beloved by the king.

40022020.author: पदार्थः
40022020.content: तयोः of them, पुत्रौ two sons, तु indeed, सम्भूतौ were born, रूपवन्तौ handsome, समाहितौ well-composed, शर्मिष्ठा Sharmishtha, अजनयत् gave birth to, पूरुं Puru, देवयानी Devayani, यदुं Yadu, तदा then,

40022020.author: Translation
40022020.content: Then, two handsome and well-composed sons were born to them; Sharmishtha gave birth to Puru, and Devayani gave birth to Yadu.

40022021.author: पदार्थः
40022021.content: पूरुस्तु Puru, दयितो beloved, राज्ञो of the king, गुणैः by qualities, मातृकृतेन and because of his mother's situation, च and, ततो then, दुःखसमाविष्टो filled with sorrow, यदुः Yadu, मातरम् to his mother, अब्रवीत् spoke,

40022021.author: Translation
40022021.content: Puru was beloved by the king due to his qualities and his mother's situation, so Yadu, filled with sorrow, then spoke to his mother.

40022022.author: पदार्थः
40022022.content: भार्गवस्य of Bhrigu, कुले in the lineage, जाता born, देवस्य of the divine one, अक्लिष्टकर्मणः whose deeds are unblemished, सहसे you endure, हृद्गतं deep-seated, दुःखम् sorrow, अवमानं insult, च and, दुःसहम् unbearable,

40022022.author: Translation
40022022.content: Yadu questioned his mother, Devayani, born in the lineage of the divine Bhrigu whose deeds are unblemished, asking why she endures such deep-seated sorrow and unbearable insult.

40022023.author: पदार्थः
40022023.content: आवां we two, च and, सहितौ together, देवि O goddess, प्रविशाव let us enter, हुताशनम् fire, राजा the king, तु but, रमतां let him enjoy, सार्धं with, दैत्यपुत्र्या the daughter of the Daitya, बहुक्षपाः for many nights,

40022023.author: Translation
40022023.content: Yadu proposed to his mother, "O goddess, let us both enter the fire together, while the king enjoys himself with the Daitya's daughter for many nights."

40022024.author: पदार्थः
40022024.content: यदि if, वा or, सहनीयं bearable, ते by you, माम् me, अनुज्ञातुम् to permit, अर्हसि you should, क्षम endure, त्वं you, न not, क्षमिष्ये I will endure, अहं I, मरिष्यामि I will die, न not, संशयः doubt,

40022024.author: Translation
40022024.content: Yadu continued, "If this is bearable for you, then you should permit me; you may endure it, but I will not, and I will surely die."

40022025.author: पदार्थः
40022025.content: पुत्रस्य of the son, भाषितं words, श्रुत्वा having heard, परमार्तस्य of the greatly distressed, रोदतः weeping, देवयानी Devayani, तु indeed, सङ्क्रुद्धा greatly enraged, सस्मार remembered, पितरं father, तदा then.

40022025.author: Translation
40022025.content: Having heard the words of her greatly distressed and weeping son, Devayani became exceedingly enraged and then remembered her father.

40022026.author: पदार्थः
40022026.content: इङ्गितं sign, तत् that, अभिज्ञाय having understood, दुहितुः of the daughter, भार्गवः Bhargava, तदा then, आगतः came, त्वरितं quickly, तत्र there, देवयानी Devayani, तु indeed, यत्र where, सा she.

40022026.author: Translation
40022026.content: Then, understanding that sign of his daughter, Bhargava quickly came to where Devayani was.

40022027.author: पदार्थः
40022027.content: दृष्ट्वा having seen, च and, अप्रकृतिस्थां not in her natural state, तां her, अप्रहृष्टां unhappy, अचेतनाम् distraught, पिता father, दुहितरं to the daughter, वाक्यं words, किम् what, एतत् this, इति thus, च and, अब्रवीत् said.

40022027.author: Translation
40022027.content: And having seen her in a disturbed, unhappy, and distraught state, the father spoke to his daughter, asking, "What is this?"

40022028.author: पदार्थः
40022028.content: पृच्छन्तं asking, असकृत् repeatedly, तं him, वै indeed, भार्गवं to Bhargava, दीप्ततेजसम् of blazing splendor, देवयानी Devayani, तु indeed, सङ्क्रुद्धा greatly enraged, पितरं to the father, वाक्यं words, अब्रवीत् said.

40022028.author: Translation
40022028.content: To that Bhargava of blazing splendor, who was repeatedly asking her, Devayani, greatly enraged, indeed spoke these words to her father.

40022029.author: पदार्थः
40022029.content: अहं I, अग्निं fire, विषं poison, तीक्ष्णं potent, अपो water, वा or, मुनिसत्तम O best of sages, भक्षयिष्ये I will consume, प्रवेक्ष्यामि I will enter, न not, तु but, शक्ष्यामि I will be able, जीवितुम् to live.

40022029.author: Translation
40022029.content: O best of sages, I will consume fire or potent poison, or I will enter water, but I will not be able to live.

40022030.author: पदार्थः
40022030.content: न not, माम् me, त्वम् you, अवजानीषे disregard, दुःखिताम् distressed, अवमानिताम् humiliated, वृक्षस्य of a tree, अवज्ञया by disrespect, ब्रह्मन् O Brahmana, छिद्यन्ते are cut off, वृक्षजीविनः tree-dwellers.

40022030.author: Translation
40022030.content: Indrani complains to Chyavana that Nahusha disregards her, who is distressed and humiliated, just as tree-dwellers are destroyed by disrespecting the tree.

40022031.author: पदार्थः
40022031.content: अवज्ञया with disrespect, च and, राजर्षिः the royal sage (Nahusha), परिभूय having insulted, च and, भार्गव O son of Bhrigu (Chyavana), मयि towards me, अवज्ञाम् disrespect, प्रयुङ्क्ते he shows, हि indeed, न not, च and, माम् me, बहु highly, मन्यते he regards.

40022031.author: Translation
40022031.content: Indrani further complains to Chyavana, stating that the royal sage Nahusha, having insulted her, indeed shows disrespect towards her and does not regard her highly.

40022032.author: पदार्थः
40022032.content: तस्याः her, तत् that, वचनम् speech, श्रुत्वा having heard, कोपेन with anger, अभिपरिप्लुतः overwhelmed, व्याहर्तुम् to speak, उपचक्राम he began, भार्गवः the son of Bhrigu (Chyavana), नहुषात्मजम् to Nahusha (descendant of Nahusha).

40022032.author: Translation
40022032.content: Having heard her words, Chyavana, the son of Bhrigu, was overwhelmed with anger and began to speak to Nahusha.

40022033.author: पदार्थः
40022033.content: यस्मात् because, माम् me, अवजानीषे you disregard, नाहुष O Nahusha, त्वम् you, दुरात्मवान् evil-minded, जरया by old age, परया extreme, जीर्णः worn out, शैथिल्यम् weakness, उपयास्यसि you will attain.

40022033.author: Translation
40022033.content: Chyavana cursed Nahusha, declaring that because the evil-minded Nahusha disregarded him, he would become extremely worn out by old age and attain great weakness.

40022034.author: पदार्थः
40022034.content: एवम् thus, उक्त्वा having spoken, दुहितरम् to his daughter, समाश्वास्य having comforted, च and, भार्गवः the son of Bhrigu (Chyavana), पुनः again, जगाम he went, ब्रह्मर्षिः the Brahmarshi, भवनम् to his abode, स्वम् his own, महायशाः highly renowned.

40022034.author: Translation
40022034.content: Having thus spoken and comforted his daughter, the highly renowned Brahmarshi Chyavana, the son of Bhrigu, returned to his own abode.

40022035.author: पदार्थः
40022035.content: सः he, एवम् thus, उक्त्वा having spoken, द्विजपुङ्गवाग्र्यः the foremost among Brahmins, सुताम् his daughter, समाश्वास्य having consoled, च and, देवयानीम् Devayani, पुनः again, ययौ went, सूर्यसमानतेजाः having splendor equal to the sun, दत्त्वा having given, च and, शापम् a curse, नहुषात्मजाय to the son of Nahusha.

40022035.author: Translation
40022035.content: Having thus spoken, the foremost Brahmin Shukra, after consoling his daughter Devayani and cursing Yayati, the son of Nahusha, departed again with a splendor like the sun. इत्यार्षे श्रीमद्रामायणे वाल्मीकीये आदिकाव्ये श्रीमदुत्तरकाण्डे ऽष्टपञ्चाशः सर्गः ।। 58 ।। Thus ends the fifty-eighth sarga of Uttara Kanda of the holy Ramayana the first epic composed by sage Valmiki.
